subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Count forwards in 10s, 5s and 2s from any multiple of 10, 5 or 2 within the same ranges; see the relationship with addition

show.line: Count in tens all the way! Ten, twenty, thirty, forty, fifty, sixty, seventy, eighty, ninety.

rounds.prompt: Count in tens. Fifty, sixty, seventy, and then?
Count in tens with me. Sixty, seventy, eighty. What comes next?
Count in fives. Thirty, thirty five, forty, and then?
Count the bundles of ten sticks. How many sticks?
Count in twos. Forty, forty two, forty four, and then?
Start at forty and add ten. Which number?

hints: Tens end in zero. Only the first digit changes.
Adding ten is one jump in the tens count.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will count in tens from sixty.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! I forgot eighty. Sixty, seventy, eighty, ninety.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count together. Sixty, seventy, eighty, ninety!

parent_line: Can count in tens, fives and twos up to 90.
